_note: Agent catalogue. Drives the cards, the start form, and the run view — one source, so a new agent is a row here rather than a new component. NOT webapp/data/agents.json, which is the six pipeline ROLES (an org chart for one agent) and is served separately at /api/agents.

agents.name: RICEFW Builder
agents.summary: Delivers a clean-core RICEFW object from a Functional Design through 12 governed steps.
agents.description: Reads an FD, decides the extensibility mode per capability, verifies every SAP object against the release catalog, builds, lints, tests, and packages. Three quality gates and three human checkpoints; no object is named from memory.

inputs.label: Functional Design
inputs.help: Upload the FD first if it is not listed.

agents.name: Explore Accelerator
agents.summary: Turns SAP scope items into Key Design Decisions and a Business Design Clarification Questionnaire.
agents.description: Reads the Process Navigator scope catalog, generates KDD rows per scope item through a five-stage agent chain, and builds the BDCQ workbook. A human sets each gap's resolution in the editor; the ones marked WRICEF are what this hands to the Realize phase.
agents._separate_from_pipeline: A DIFFERENT agent in a DIFFERENT SAP Activate phase, not a stage of the RICEFW pipeline. It has its own repository, its own runtime (Node/Express) and its own release cadence; the only connection is the handoff below. Listing it here is what makes the dashboard a catalogue rather than one pipeline with a side door.

handoff.note: Only rows a human has marked Resolution = WRICEF in the KDD editor cross over. Generation never sets that field, so the handoff is deliberately not automatic.

inputs.label: Scope catalog
inputs.help: Produced by the SAP Deck Agent Chrome extension from Process Navigator, then uploaded to the app. Not held in this dashboard.
